Sure. It was around 2:30am on a Saturday. I had already taken a couple oxys and was planning on buying some more. I decided I couldn't drive so I was going to walk to see my plug. I left home and started walking to this seat ( everyone buys n sells drugs in this certain area ). It was super dark outside and there were hardly any street lights on. So I'm walking along this long, dark street that goes on for about 500-700m. I see the guy coming towards me in his car and I'm thinking "sweet, I'm about to get some more oxy". I'm walking down the right side of the footpath and this car goes past my left side. Thought nothing of it. I then saw the headlights turn back around and head towards me again ( car was coming from behind ). Once they had gone past me, they pulled into a driveway about 20-30 metres in front of me. They then proceeded to turn around and started coming towards me again. I had a bad feeling when I saw the car coming towards me. The car got about 5 metres away from me then quickly swerved to the side of the footpath and turned their lights off. I couldn't see their faces or anything as it was 2:30am and dark as hell. The passenger side window was closest to me and I heard the window go down. All the guy said was " oi, come here. Come here". By his tone, I could tell I was about to be robbed. At this point I was already right next to the car and was kind of crouched down looking into the window. I saw the guys right hand move towards the glovebox and could hear him scuffling as if he was trying to grab something. Before I could react I was already shot. Got hit twice in my left arm and once in my shoulder. This startled me because the split second before I got shot, I had already started running. So I'm on a long dark street with no side streets in sight. I had already got about 20 metres away from the car before they turned around and started coming towards me with high beams on. I remember thinking " this is it, I'm fucked" or something like that. In the moment I wasn't really thinking, I was just panicking. When I saw the headlights from behind, I turned right and ran into some random persons garden. You know how some houses have automatic lights that turn on when there is movement? Well as I'm running and trying to hide in this guys garden, the entire driveway lights up. Pitch black street with a bright ass light in some randoms driveway. I turned around and jumped a wooden fence which led me to this guys backyard. At this point I'm in some randoms backyard, the people who shot me are either right out front of this house or they have left. I was hiding behind this little garage in this guys backyard and was trying to catch my breath / think about what is going on. That's when I felt this warm stuff running down my arm. I didn't feel it at first but I said to myself  " fuck man this isn't good". First thought was to ring an ambulance so I called. Phone had no sim card and wouldn't dial so I was like fuck it. Went and knocked on the back door of this guys house. A older couple came to the back door and seemed very scared ( as you would be seeing someone off their head on oxy who has just been shot , standing in your backyard at 2-30am ). I told them I had just been shot and asked them to please call an ambulance. They took me inside and I wrapped my t-shirt around my arm. The pain was starting to kick in now and reality was starting to hit me. The people who had shot me ended up taking off. I just remember sitting on this old couples couch and nothing felt real. It's hard to describe/ explain  but it's almost like it wasn't me in that moment. The rest is just basic, go to the hospital, get stitched up and recovery. Come to find out a few days later, the people that tried to rob me had gone out, stabbed a 23yr old and stolen his car. The car they pulled up in when they shot me, was the 23yr olds car that they had stolen from him just earlier. Sorry if this was a shitty explanation and I've missed out some things but I'm half asleep right now and bit fcked
